# libpng: FetchContent + copy prebuilt pnglibconf.h
# libpng headers require pnglibconf.h (normally generated by cmake configure).
# The repo ships scripts/pnglibconf.h.prebuilt which works for -fsyntax-only.
# Also needs zlib headers since png.h includes zlib.h.
FetchContent_Declare(libpng_ext
    GIT_REPOSITORY https://github.com/pnggroup/libpng.git
    GIT_TAG        v1.6.44
    GIT_SHALLOW    TRUE
)

FetchContent_GetProperties(libpng_ext)
if(NOT libpng_ext_POPULATED)
    FetchContent_Populate(libpng_ext)
    # Copy the prebuilt config header so png.h can find it
    file(COPY "${libpng_ext_SOURCE_DIR}/scripts/pnglibconf.h.prebuilt"
         DESTINATION "${libpng_ext_SOURCE_DIR}")
    file(RENAME "${libpng_ext_SOURCE_DIR}/pnglibconf.h.prebuilt"
                "${libpng_ext_SOURCE_DIR}/pnglibconf.h")
endif()

# Reuse zlib headers from the zlib FetchContent (already populated by zlib tests)
# If zlib_ext is not available, fetch it here too
if(NOT zlib_ext_SOURCE_DIR)
    FetchContent_Declare(zlib_ext
        GIT_REPOSITORY https://github.com/madler/zlib.git
        GIT_TAG        v1.3.1
        GIT_SHALLOW    TRUE
    )
    FetchContent_GetProperties(zlib_ext)
    if(NOT zlib_ext_POPULATED)
        FetchContent_Populate(zlib_ext)
        execute_process(
            COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND}
                -B "${zlib_ext_BINARY_DIR}"
                -S "${zlib_ext_SOURCE_DIR}"
                -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=${CMAKE_C_COMPILER}
            WORKING_DIRECTORY ${zlib_ext_SOURCE_DIR}
            OUTPUT_QUIET ERROR_QUIET
        )
    endif()
endif()

dtt_add_external_lib_tests(
    LIB_PREFIX   libpng
    DTT_FILE     ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/annotations/external/libpng.dtt
    INCLUDE_DIRS "${libpng_ext_SOURCE_DIR};${zlib_ext_SOURCE_DIR};${zlib_ext_BINARY_DIR}"
)
